attributes.action: Provide patients with complex medical histories 1-2 fixed GPs.
attributes.additional_details:
Currently, the NHS GP system frequently operates on “any available GP” basis. For patients with complex, rare, or multi medical conditions, this lacks continuity causing confusion and lack of understanding/knowledge and can be dangerous.
Every appointment with a new GP requires the patient to spend time re-explaining a lifetime of complex medical history, often resulting in:
Fragmented care
Patient burnout
Inefficiency 
We understand the pressure GPs face but this will keep the patients safe.
attributes.background: We want the government to mandate that GP surgeries assign and guarantee a designated team of no more than two specific GPs to any patient diagnosed with complex, chronic, or multi-system medical history.

rejection.details: We are unclear about what action you are seeking as a patient can already request a named GP: https://www.bma.org.uk/advice-and-support/gp-practices/managing-your-practice-list/requirement-for-all-patients-to-have-a-named-gp
